sections.description: Run the correlation, example data, tour and help.

buttons.label: Run FCS
buttons.description: Correlate every ticked burst file with every ticked channel pair and fit each curve.

buttons.label: Stop
buttons.description: Cancel between burst files; the previous results are kept.

buttons.label: Example
buttons.description: Generate a small deterministic demonstration data set (photon stream and burst table) and add it.

buttons.label: Guide
buttons.description: A step-by-step walk through the tool on the demonstration data.

buttons.label: Help
buttons.description: Explain burst-wise FCS, the settings and the fits.

sections.description: Add and remove inputs.

buttons.label: Files...
buttons.description: Choose BUR or BST burst tables.

buttons.label: Folder...
buttons.description: Choose an analysis folder; its burst tables are found inside.

buttons.label: Database...
buttons.description: Resolve a burst analysis dataset from MMFDB.

buttons.label: All
buttons.description: Tick every input.

buttons.label: None
buttons.description: Untick every input.

buttons.label: Remove
buttons.description: Remove the selected input.

buttons.label: Clear
buttons.description: Remove every input and every curve.

sections.name: files
sections.description: Burst folders or BUR/BST files. Drop files or folders on the window to add them; click Use to include or exclude one.

sections.title: Correlator
sections.description: The multi-tau correlator and the photon window of each burst.

sections.label: FCS bins (B)
sections.description: Number of linear correlation bins per cascade.

sections.label: Cascades
sections.description: Number of multi-tau cascades.

sections.label: Fine grid
sections.description: Use the fine (micro-time resolved) correlation grid.

sections.label: Padding +- (ms)
sections.description: Photon time added before and after each burst before correlation.

sections.title: Fitting
sections.description: The per-curve fit and its window.

sections.label: Mode
sections.description: Per-curve fit: none, single-component diffusion, or a MaxEnt distribution of diffusion times.

sections.label: MaxEnt reg (log10)
sections.description: MaxEnt regularisation strength as log10(reg). Used in MaxEnt mode.

sections.label: tau_D min (ms)
sections.description: Lower diffusion-time bound of the MaxEnt grid (0 = automatic). Used in MaxEnt mode.

sections.label: tau_D max (ms)
sections.description: Upper diffusion-time bound of the MaxEnt grid (0 = automatic). Used in MaxEnt mode.

sections.label: t_min (ms)
sections.description: Lower correlation-time bound of the fit window (0 = from the start). The left line on the correlation plot drags it.

sections.label: t_max (ms)
sections.description: Upper correlation-time bound of the fit window (0 = to the end). The right line on the correlation plot drags it.

sections.name: pairs
sections.description: FCS channel pairs: a pair of routing-channel lists, optionally gated in micro time. Equal sides make an auto-correlation.
Edit the channel pairs.

buttons.label: Add pair
buttons.description: Add a channel pair to edit.

buttons.label: Remove pair
buttons.description: Remove the selected channel pair.

buttons.label: Load pairs...
buttons.description: Load channel pairs, or a detector setup, from JSON.

buttons.label: Save pairs...
buttons.description: Save the channel pairs with their micro-time gates as JSON.

buttons.label: Show JSON
buttons.description: Show the channel pairs as JSON.

sections.name: curves
sections.description: The correlation curves of every burst and pair. Filter by file or pair name; select one to show it in the plots.
